title: Laughter in the Face of Spiritual Battle
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he dives into the powerful story of Elijah and the prophets of Baal, exploring the theme of spiritual conflict and the importance of standing firm in your faith. Learn how to recognize and mock the enemies of God in your life, just as Elijah did, and discover the freedom that comes from being fully surrendered to the Holy Spirit. This sermon will challenge and equip you to live a life of boldness and faith, unafraid to confront the forces of darkness head-on.
